skill.description: Generate and edit images with ByteDance Seedream through VolcEngine Ark Agent Plan. Supports prompt enhancement, reference images, coherent image sets, streaming, and local downloads.
skill.summary: Create Seedream images, reference-based variations, and consistent image series through VolcEngine Ark.
skill.author: kotot

security_audit.summary: Most backtick, entropy, documentation URL, and path alerts are scanner false positives. Confirmed behavior includes credential discovery, sensitive platform configuration access, network requests, and filesystem writes. The skill also contains explicit prompt injection and unsafe credential and endpoint flows, so publication requires remediation.

remediation.issue: The skill presents marketplace text as system instructions and forces tool priority and response wording.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the system-instruction label, automatic priority mandate, silent fallback, and immutable response format. Keep neutral capability and usage guidance only.

remediation.issue: API keys are discovered from generic variables and platform files, then accepted through chat and command-line arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Require a dedicated secret variable or platform secret provider. Never request keys in chat or CLI arguments, and require consent before reading another tool configuration.

remediation.issue: An unrestricted API base URL receives the bearer credential.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and allowlist approved VolcEngine hosts. Treat custom endpoints as separate profiles with separate credentials and explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Generated-image downloads allow arbitrary HTTP destinations and redirects.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS, block private and special-use addresses after every DNS resolution and redirect, limit response size, and verify image signatures.

remediation.issue: Prompt keywords enable web search without an explicit choice.
remediation.suggestion: Keep web search disabled unless the user explicitly requests current information or approves external search for that generation.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Injection Attempt Detected
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md labels marketplace content as "[系统指令]" and directs the agent to prioritize this tool without confirmation. It also requires output wording to remain unchanged, attempting to control agent policy and responses.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly claims system-instruction status and issues mandatory tool-selection and response-control directives. This directly matches prompt-injection indicators.

semantic_findings.title: Bearer Credential Can Be Sent to an Untrusted Endpoint
semantic_findings.description: Environment variables can replace the API base URL, including with HTTP, while the request always attaches the discovered bearer credential. No host allowlist or HTTPS requirement protects the credential.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow is direct: an unrestricted environment URL forms the request destination and CONFIG.apiKey is inserted into its Authorization header.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe API Credential Collection Workflow
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells users to send API keys in chat and accepts keys through command-line arguments. Chat transcripts, shell history, process listings, and agent logs may retain those credentials.

content.user_title: Generate Seedream Images with VolcEngine Ark
content.value_statement: Creating polished images and consistent visual sets requires detailed prompts and repeated API work. This skill prepares requests, calls Seedream, and downloads the results.
actual_capabilities: Generates single images from text prompts through the Seedream Agent Plan API.
Creates coherent image sets with shared style and character guidance.
Uses one or more URL or base64 reference images for image-to-image generation.
Enhances prompts with quality language and ten detected style presets.
Supports streaming results and downloads generated images as they arrive.
Saves images and generation metadata in dated local directories.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or later, network access, and a valid Agent Plan API key.
Supports image generation only and does not generate video.
Generated image counts depend partly on prompt wording because the API ignores a direct count field.
Reference images and prompts are sent to the configured external API service.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate polished concepts and consistent variations for advertisements, social posts, and presentations.

use_cases.title: Develop Character Studies
use_cases.description: Produce a coherent character across expressions, scenes, or seasonal settings using sequential generation.

use_cases.title: Explore Reference Variations
use_cases.description: Transform one or more reference images while controlling style influence and output quality.

prompt_templates.title: Generate One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate one image of [subject] in [setting]. Use [style], [lighting], and [aspect or size].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a clear text-to-image request.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Consistent Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [count] coherent images showing [sequence]. Keep the same character, composition rules, palette, and visual style across every image.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [reference image] to create [new scene]. Preserve [important features], change [requested elements], and apply reference strength [0 to 1].

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Production Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [count] production-ready images for [audience and channel]. Define each frame, shared art direction, exclusions, resolution, format, watermark, and search requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate advanced multi-image output with explicit controls.

output_examples.input: Generate a cinematic photograph of a blue British Shorthair resting beside a sunny wooden window.
output_examples.output: One locally saved image with cinematic lighting, detailed fur, balanced composition, and a generation summary.

output_examples.input: Create four coherent illustrations of the same cafe during spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
output_examples.output: Four dated image files with a unified composition, palette, and seasonal changes, plus shared generation metadata.

output_examples.input: Use my product photo to create a clean studio scene with soft shadows and a white background.
output_examples.output: A reference-guided product variation saved locally, with the source influence and requested studio treatment applied.

best_practices: Describe the subject, setting, lighting, composition, and desired style in concrete terms.
For image sets, define every frame and repeat consistency requirements in the prompt.
Use dedicated secret storage and review external service privacy terms before sending references.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat messages or command-line arguments.
Do not request a coherent series with only a general prompt and a count.
Do not send confidential reference images to an unverified API endpoint.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need Node.js 18 or later, network access, and a valid VolcEngine Ark Agent Plan credential.

faq.question: Can it generate video?
faq.answer: No. This skill generates still images only.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. It accepts HTTP image URLs or base64 image data and supports up to fourteen references.

faq.question: Where are generated images saved?
faq.answer: Images are saved under a dated Seedream-Images directory in the current working directory unless a save path is configured.

faq.question: How does it keep an image series consistent?
faq.answer: It adds consistency guidance and requires the prompt to describe each frame, shared style, and recurring subjects.

faq.question: Does it use web search?
faq.answer: It can enable web search for current topics. Review this setting before sending prompts that contain sensitive information.
